capabilities: Chat with Cola AI in a sidebar
Send the currently open file as automatic context
Quote or send selected text to the chat
Insert Cola's reply at the cursor
disambiguation: It does not run its own AI model; it only bridges Obsidian to the separate Cola desktop app over a local WebSocket.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states the connection is local-only (127.0.0.1) and that AI processing and privacy are handled by the Cola app itself.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with an external AI assistant that is aware of the file you currently have open.

relations.evidence: This plugin connects to Cola's local channel plugin via WebSocket.

requires.name: Cola's Obsidian channel plugin (installed from Cola's settings)

summary: Sidebar chat client for the Cola AI desktop app that sends your currently open file as context and can insert replies into the editor.
